newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys 7,000 tns of Aug MTBE at $270/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 7,000 tns of Aug MTBE at $270/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded a tender to buy 7,000 tonnes of August methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) at $270 per tonne, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis, a CPC official said on Monday.
The tender sought the gasoline octane enhancer to be delivered during August 6-20 on a c-and-f basis to Kaohsiung or Keelung.
The tender closed on June 23 and offers were valid for two days.
The price was on par with CPC's last purchase of 7,000 tonnes of MTBE for July 6-20 at $270 per tonne c+f from Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC).
